entries.positive_observation: The uncapped compact yellow mascot retains the high forehead, receding temples, dark-brown side-parted and slicked-back hair, short side/back hair, narrow sideburns and both dark-brown eyebrows. It has green-ringed solid black eyes without white sclera, one restrained serious closed mouth, a clean-shaven face, no glasses, and no human nose, ears or skin. The left-facing near-profile pose, leftward gaze, upright shoulders, crop and directional light remain recognizable. The dark olive uniform retains its gold shoulder boards, two red densely gold-embroidered collar patches, narrow pale shirt edge, one black-and-silver throat cross and one gold chest eagle, with no duplicated insignia. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, pinching, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. The pale warm gray-beige mottled backplate remains complete through the original rectangle, with no headgear, frame, note, transparency or replacement backdrop added.
entries.alpha_decision: visible-alpha-v1: the exact source is RGBA 156x210 with alpha extrema [255,255] and all 32760 pixels at alpha 255. The full white/cyan/source-alpha sheet and complete unchanged RGB raw show an intact opaque rectangular backplate and solid uniform with no holes, haze, halo or transparent exterior. The returned 1776x2368 master is RGB, so returned_alpha_extrema is null and no native_alpha_accepted claim applies. RGB art is approved only for the later source-compatible BILINEAR alpha-only restoration of this fully opaque source alpha, followed by a separate final visual review. No repair was performed in this review.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual hair strands, the finest collar embroidery and the neck-cross interior are not fully resolved at 156x210. The visible hairline, feature counts, positions and broad shapes were checked without claiming unreadable micro-detail; those source-resolution limits are not rejection grounds.
